title: Architecture of the 8 MDa Hdr-Vhu-Fwd super-assembly in class I methanogens.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Fetched RCSB PDB (Protein Data Bank) metadata for 9SFI: exists, cites this paper, 4.0 Å cryo-EM (cryogenic electron microscopy) reconstruction from 110,231 particles. EMDB (Electron Microscopy Data Bank) entry EMD-54825 returns HTTP 200. Did not download maps or coordinates.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Other deposits (9T1S, about 12 local EMDB maps, 2 subtomogram averages), the source-data files for Fig. 2 and Extended Data Fig. 9, and the GTDB (Genome Taxonomy Database) taxonomic-distribution analysis. Supplementary file listing timed out and could not be retrieved.

a1_downloadable.note: PDB 9SFI and EMDB EMD-54825 are public (checked the metadata endpoints). Strains are available on request only.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: This is a structure paper: two atomic models and a set of density maps. There is no table of examples with a measured outcome column; any label would have to be built from other sources.

a3_inputs_present.note: Sequences and coordinates sit in the PDB entries; not relevant given A2 fails.

a4_units_stated.note: Not applicable; there is no label table.

a5_enough_rows.note: Two complexes (252 chains in total, mostly copies of the same few subunits). That is far under the 400-row minimum for any supervised task.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: Coordinates are tens of MB; composite maps are probably hundreds of MB (not checked).

a7_counts_match_paper.note: PDB metadata cites this paper and its DOI, consistent with the text.

a8_label_provenance.note: There is no label, so its source can't be traced. The structures themselves are experimental measurements.

honest_claim_h3: No machine-learning claim is possible: the data is one large structure plus one variant, not a set of labelled examples.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use methanogen protein sequences to predict whether a species builds the large ring-shaped electron-transfer complex or the smaller one.
plain_idea.train_on: Archaeal genomes from GTDB (Genome Taxonomy Database), each with its gene content for the complex's subunits. The number of labelled genomes is unknown, because the labels came from the authors' own inference.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a species has the class I super-assembly or the class II one. The 'true answer' comes from gene-presence rules the authors applied, not from a measurement.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Little: the label is a deterministic rule over gene presence, so a model would just relearn that rule.

label_elsewhere.sources: None; the structures are unique to this paper.
label_elsewhere.why: No external labelled set exists for this task.

ml_idea: None viable. The only conceivable task (classifying the complex type from gene content) has labels computed from the features.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count the labelled examples: there are 2 structures, so the project fails immediately.

verdict_reason: Single cryo-EM structure paper: two complexes, no label column and no tabular dataset, so A2 and A5 fail.
